mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_registration (activity_id, user_id, registration_time, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{userId}, #{registrationTime}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activity_registration WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
SELECT activity_id as activityId, COUNT(*) as count FROM activity_registration GROUP BY activity_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT AVG(registration_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) as registration_count FROM activity_registration GROUP BY activity_id ) as counts
SELECT status as `key`, COUNT(*) as `value` FROM activity_registration GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') as label, COUNT(*) as `value` FROM activity_registration WHERE DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') BETWEEN #{startMonth} AND #{endMonth} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY label ASC

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(created_at), '-W', WEEK(created_at, 1)) as label, COUNT(*) as `value` FROM activity_registration WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(created_at), '-W', WEEK(created_at, 1)) BETWEEN #{startWeek} AND #{endWeek} GROUP BY CONCAT(YEAR(created_at), '-W', WEEK(created_at, 1)) ORDER BY label ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as label, COUNT(*) as `value` FROM activity_registration WHERE DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY label ASC
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) END as confirmation_rate FROM activity_registration
SELECT user_id as userId, COUNT(*) as count FROM activity_registration GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT user_id FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
